dungeonconfig.config.option.titleScreenB: Shows the Dungeon Configs button next to Singleplayer on the title screen. Ctrl + K opens the page either way.
dungeonconfig.config.option.menuBackgrou: Picture, animated GIF or video behind this menu: a file in %s/bg, a link, or leave empty to pick a random one from that folder. Set to none to turn it off. Videos need FFmpeg, installed or placed in config/dungeonconfig/bin.
How strongly the menu background is blurred so the menu stays easy to read. 0 keeps it sharp.
How much the menu background picture is darkened.
Frame rate for video and animated GIF menu backgrounds. 60 is smoother, 30 uses less CPU.
dungeonconfig.config.option.menuMusic.de: Music that plays while this menu is open: a file in %s/bgmusic, a link, or leave empty for random tracks from that folder. Set to none to turn it off. Ogg and wav play as they are, other formats and links need FFmpeg.
dungeonconfig.config.option.menuMusicVol: Volume of the menu music. The game's master volume applies on top.
dungeonconfig.screen.no_mods: No mods use Dungeon Config yet
dungeonconfig.screen.badge.server: This server uses %s while you play on it. Changes here apply in singleplayer.
dungeonconfig.screen.save_failed: Couldn't save settings, see the log
dungeonconfig.screen.confirm.title: Unsaved Changes
dungeonconfig.screen.confirm.body: Some settings have changed since you last saved. What would you like to do?
dungeonconfig.screen.ffmpeg.title: Download FFmpeg?
dungeonconfig.screen.ffmpeg.body1: Your menu background or music needs FFmpeg, a free program that plays videos and most audio formats. Dungeon Config can download it into config/dungeonconfig/bin for you, where every mod's settings menu can use it.
dungeonconfig.screen.ffmpeg.disclaimer: FFmpeg is third-party software made by the FFmpeg project and licensed under the GPL. It is not made by Dungeon Config, which only checks the download against the checksum the provider publishes. Only continue if you trust this source. You can also install FFmpeg yourself instead.
dungeonconfig.screen.ffmpeg.failed: FFmpeg download failed, see the log
dungeonconfig.screen.restart.title: Restart Needed
dungeonconfig.screen.restart.world: Some of the settings you saved only take effect after you leave and rejoin the world.
dungeonconfig.screen.restart.game: Some of the settings you saved only take effect after you restart the game.
dungeonconfig.screen.restart.pending.wor: Saved. Applies after you rejoin the world.
dungeonconfig.screen.restart.pending.gam: Saved. Applies after you restart the game.
dungeonconfig.screen.restart.needs.world: Changes apply after rejoining the world.
dungeonconfig.screen.restart.needs.game: Changes apply after restarting the game.
